editorial:
Imagine waking up to a world where a nasty virus has turned everyone around you into bloodthirsty zombies. That is exactly the mess you get into here. You follow a group of survivors trying to find a safe spot while the city falls apart around them. The vibe is very gritty and tense, making you feel like you are right there in the middle of the chaos. It does not waste time with long talks; it gets straight to the action and the scares, which keeps the energy high from the very first scene.

What really works is how the movie handles the tension and the fast-paced fight scenes. The acting is solid enough to make you care if the characters live or die, though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable. If you love zombie flicks that focus more on survival than deep philosophy, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: In the final act, the survivors realize that the virus is spreading faster than they thought. After a big showdown with a massive horde of zombies, only a few characters make it to the extraction point. The twist is that one of the survivors was bitten early on but kept it a secret. As they think they are finally safe, the infected person turns, leaving the remaining survivors in a desperate fight for their lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie survival stories and non-stop action.
